question: By how much is 65% of 75 greater than 3/5 of 45?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

First value = 65% of 75 = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

Second value = 3/5 of 45 = 3 × 9 = 27

Required difference = 48.75 − 27 = 21.75

**∴ The correct answer is 21.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 65% of 75 = 48.75
 
 3/5 of 45 = 27
 
• 
 Difference = 21.75
 
• 

**Given:**

First value = 65% of 75

Second value = 3/5 of 45

**Calculations:**

⇒ First value = (65 ÷ 100) × 75

⇒ First value = 0.65 × 75 = 48.75

⇒ Second value = (3 ÷ 5) × 45

⇒ Second value = 3 × 9 = 27

⇒ Required Difference = First value − Second value

⇒ Required Difference = 48.75 − 27

⇒ Required Difference = 21.75

**∴ The correct answer is 21.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Calculation

x% of y can be calculated as (x ÷ 100) × y. Alternatively, x% of y is always equal to y% of x.

Fraction to Decimal

To simplify calculations, commonly used fractions can be converted to percentages or decimals. For example, 3/5 is equivalent to 60% or 0.6.

BODMAS Rule

Calculations should systematically follow the order of Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.
